shared_elements: human or anthropomorphic figure in profile
justification: The main shared content is only that both include human/anthropomorphic depiction in profile and some repeated patterning. A is a single large, naturalistic profile head with elaborate curled hair/beard and a tall headdress, while B is a multi-register schematic scene with small figures, animals, and bands of signs, so the iconographic scheme and arrangement are essentially unrelated.
